Name: Luny's Swamp Fields (More Grass)
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sHoUQXE.png[/img]﻿
This pack changes the grass on the farm to shades of purple or green, with tiny mushrooms and flowers sprinkled in. I made this grass retexture to better compliment the color options of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27631]Aimon's Small Swamp Farm[/url]. After much debate between the purple or green color for the farm, I finally settled on purple. It's so pretty and unique! But most grass retextures (or vanilla) looked a little out of place with their lush green colors. So I started creating my own pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url] that better matched my cute swampy farm.

NOTE: If you're having issues with the swamp grass appearing all over the game and not just your farm, here's one way to change that if it bothers you:
[list]
[*]Go to your StardewValley/mods folder and open the MoreGrass folder.
[*]Open config (may only appear after the game has been loaded once with More Grass installed)
[*]Add "farm" under   "LocationsWhiteList": [   like this:
[/list][code]﻿  "LocationsWhiteList": [
    "farm"
  ],
[/code]I tried to have this built into my mod pack, but I couldn't get it to work during testing without changing this directly in More Grass. If anyone knows how to get this setting to work in an individual pack then please let me know! (；￣Д￣)


BIG thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aimon111/about-me?gameId=1303]Aimon[/url] for doing such a fantastic job on the map commission! I absolutely love it! (´,,•ω•,,)♡
If you too are interested in a cute swampy farm, perhaps in purple, then check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27631]Aimon's Small Swamp Farm[/url]! And check out their other mods while you're at it, I absolutely love all the maps they make!



[img]https://i.imgur.com/lTKkn3N.png[/img]﻿
To install:
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url] to work! Install that first.
Download the file and unzip the contents (or unzip and move the folder "[MG] Luny's Purple Swamp Grass") into your StardewValley/mods folder. Done!
